input.description: Hash requirements file and print HEAD
input.command:
$p = '.recursive/run/115-effect-foldkit-runtime-migration/00-requirements.md'
Write-Output "Get-Location: $(Get-Location)"
Write-Output "Target: $p"
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p) {
  $h = Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $p
  Write-Output "Algorithm: $($h.Algorithm)"
  Write-Output "Hash: $($h.Hash)"
  Write-Output "ResolvedPath: $($h.Path)"
} else {
  Write-Output "FILE NOT FOUND: $p"
}
$head = git rev-parse HEAD 2>&1
Write-Output "git rev-parse HEAD: $head"
Write-Output "git rev-parse exit code: $LASTEXITCODE"
